title: Agedashi Tofu in Spicy Thai Broth
description: A twist on the classic Japanese dish, agedashi tofu is served in a spicy Thai-inspired broth with intense flavors.
instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes and coat with agedashi flour.
Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the oil and set aside.
In the same pot, add the minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, fish sauce, Thai red curry paste, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the fried tofu back into the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and season with salt to taste.
Serve the agedashi tofu in the spicy Thai broth and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
